summary: Three-way comparator over the float at offset +0xC of two arguments: returns 1 when a1's field is greater than a2's, 0 when they are equal, and -1 when a1's field is smaller. Consistent with a sort or ordering callback.

operations.description: Promote both float fields at offset +0xC of a1 and a2 to double for comparison.
Guard on *(float*)(a1+0xC) > *(float*)(a2+0xC): when strictly greater, return 1.
Return 1 when a1's field is strictly greater than a2's.
Guard on *(float*)(a1+0xC) >= *(float*)(a2+0xC): equality (not strictly greater) yields 0.
Return 0 when the two fields compare equal.
Return -1 when a1's field is strictly smaller than a2's (the fall-through case).

unresolved: The semantic meaning of the compared float at offset +0xC (what ordering quantity it represents) is unknown.
Only a1's field has an evidence reference; the equal read of a2's +0xC field is only covered by source:raw.
What object type a1/a2 point to is unknown, so the field has no named meaning.
